test_title: PYST 52: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the Inter-Services Organisations (Command, Control & Discipline) Rules, which came into effect from May 2025?

options.text: To establish a unified military command structure
To integrate paramilitary forces under the Ministry of Defence

solution:
The correct answer is __**To establish a unified military command structure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Inter-Services Organisations (Command, Control & Discipline) Rules aim to **establish an integrated and unified military command structure** within India's armed forces.
 
• This reform promotes better **coordination, efficiency, and synergy** among the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.
 
• The unified command structure is designed to **streamline decision-making** and enable quicker responses to security challenges.
 
• The rules enable the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) and other integrated commands to **exercise administrative and disciplinary control** over personnel from all three services.
 
• This initiative is part of broader defence reforms aimed at **modernising India's military and enhancing its operational capabilities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Army (Land)**

 
 
• Role: Protects land borders, deals with internal security, combats terrorism, and provides disaster relief.
 
• Focus: Ground operations, infantry, tanks, artillery, and securing vast land territories. 
 
 
 
• **Indian Navy (Sea)**
 
 
• Role: Safeguards maritime borders, controls sea lanes, protects trade, and projects power across oceans.
 
• Focus: Warships, submarines, aircraft carriers, and naval aviation for maritime security. 
 
 
 
• **Indian Air Force (Air)**
 
 
• Role: Secures airspace, provides air support, conducts surveillance, and executes aerial warfare.
 
• Focus: Fighter jets, transport aircraft, helicopters, drones, and missile systems.
